reasoning: The agent treated failures as diagnostic signals: it isolated the parity failure to TF32, reverted every optimization that regressed correctness or latency cleanly back to the frozen model.py, and abandoned hanging/unpromising directions quickly to conserve budget. It redirected effort toward the kernel-overhead hypothesis (torch.compile/CUDA graphs) and ended by explicitly rejecting a FAIL_REGRESSION in favor of the fastest passing variant — squarely matching the level-8 anchor, with only loose noise-attribution keeping it below a perfect 10.
